_note: REFERENCE SPEC to copy into the ElevenLabs dashboard (Agent -> Tools -> Add webhook tool). It is NOT an import file; the dashboard's field names may differ. Replace {{DOMAIN}} with your HTTPS domain. Store the API key as a SECRET header value, never in the prompt.

tools.name: lookup_profile
tools.description: Look up what we remember about the person on the phone. Call this at the start of every call.

body.caller_id: the caller's phone number [VERIFY: use ElevenLabs' system dynamic variable for caller number, e.g. system__caller_id, in the dashboard]

tools.name: get_flood_status
tools.description: Get current flood risk, nearest gauge readings and active weather alerts for an address. Use when the caller asks about flooding near them.

query.address: Street address, or nearest cross street / ZIP code, as the caller said it

tools.name: get_shelters
tools.description: Find the nearest shelters FEMA lists as open. Give location (ZIP, city, address or landmark) or lat+lon. Tell the caller to confirm a shelter is open; if none, read the message (call 211).

query.location: caller's ZIP code, city, address or landmark (or use lat+lon instead)

tools.name: save_profile
tools.description: Save household details ONLY after the caller says yes to being remembered.

tools.name: forget_profile
tools.description: Delete everything we saved about the caller. Use when they ask to be forgotten.

post_call._note: After each call, send the transcript to POST /post-call (use ElevenLabs' post-call webhook if available [VERIFY], or call it from a small script). Stores only the structured triage result, not the transcript.
